summary: protolambda 称 EIP-7928 BAL 将改变以太坊扩容路径，让更简单的验证基础设施重新可行。SEAL 发布 RFC，为协议提供标准化的运营安全成熟度证明。leekt 提交 ERC-7780 新增模块类型。Anoma 协议适配器部署到以太坊主网。

keywords_en: SEAL issues an operational security maturity RFC
the Anoma protocol adapter goes live
summary_en: protolambda said EIP-7928 BAL will change Ethereum's scaling path and make simpler verifier infrastructure viable again. SEAL issued an RFC giving protocols a standard way to show operational security maturity. leekt submitted new ERC-7780 module types. The Anoma protocol adapter deployed to Ethereum mainnet.
